skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Recognize, understand, and analyze the nature of bidding, bidding principles, bidding organization methods, and contractor selection forms.
Recognize, understand, and analyze the steps of bidding planning for investment projects.
Understand and analyze the tender selection process.
Know, understand, apply, and analyze the content of drafting tender invitation documents for various types of tenders.
Recognize, understand, apply, and analyze the evaluation process of tender submission documents and various evaluation methods.
Understand and analyze the government's management of bidding activities in Vietnam.
Possess research skills, analysis, synthesis, and evaluation skills for bidding content.
Develop independent learning, independent work, problem detection, analysis, and resolution skills related to bidding.
Collaborate and participate in group activities to complete group tasks effectively.
